recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a future generated build drops canonical entries from the References to this Resource / Resource References section.
issue_request: FHIR-16455 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core correction asking that resources referenced using canonical appear in the generated resources-that-use-this-resource list.
initial_application: Jira records November 2018 comments from Grahame Grieve that the issue had been fixed. No Jira-keyed git commit was found in the FHIR checkout; the old in-repo Java generator has since moved to the external Kindling build dependency.
additional_context: Active resource-page templates include the <%resref%> generated section, and source/fhir.ini lists the checked resources as active. Representative current source elements such as ActivityDefinition.library, ClinicalUseDefinition.library, Measure.library, and PlanDefinition.library are canonical targetProfile references to Library. The current CI build renders those resources in Library's References to this Resource / Resource References list, and StructureDefinition shows similar canonical/profile reverse references.
reconciliation: No FHIR source edit was made. The current built output already satisfies the issue request, and any future generator-level regression would belong in HL7/kindling before updating the FHIR build dependency.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive correction asking that resources referenced using canonical appear in the generated resources-that-use-this-resource list; Jira comments say it was fixed in November 2018.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final request and that the intended application was a generated reverse-reference fix, not a specific resource model edit.
